summary.text: Matthew Hicks is a Democratic state representative from Merrimack District 24 who has served since December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, after advancing from the September 8, 2026 primary. He is a former school principal and teacher.

paragraphs.text: Hicks lives in Concord, New Hampshire, according to Ballotpedia.

He earned a master's degree from the University of New Hampshire, a master's degree from Harvard University, and a doctorate in education leadership and policy from the University of New Hampshire in 2018.

His career experience includes working as principal and a teacher with Shaker Road School, and he has served on the Concord Planning Board, on the executive committee of the Central NH Planning Commission, and as a trustee of NH Civics.
